author: Gustave Flaubert

authorInfo.bio: Gustave Flaubert was a French novelist. He has been considered the leading exponent of literary realism in his country and abroad. He is known especially for his debut novel Madame Bovary (1857), his Correspondence, and his scrupulous devotion to his style and aesthetics. The celebrated writer Guy de Maupassant was a protégé of Flaubert.

sourceTitle: Over Strand and Field: A Record of Travel through Brittany
description: "Over Strand and Field: A Record of Travel through Brittany" by Gustave Flaubert is a travel narrative likely written in the late 19th century. The work vividly details the author's explorations through the scenic and historic landscapes of Brittany, France, reflecting upon various châteaux, towns, and regional life along the way.
